conditions.provider: Synthetic axios.post responses only; zero live network requests. This does not measure actual LLM quality or provider latency.
conditions.latency: 120 + (chunkId % 3) * 40 ms; source chunk IDs descend from 8 to 1 to permit out-of-order completion.
conditions.scope: Production translateFilesWithCoordinator -> real registry/factory -> GeminiTranslator, including structural validation, atomic translation/cache/progress writes and fsync.
conditions.excluded: Module build/load, fixture and backup preparation, post-run byte/structure/equality assertions, report generation and cleanup.
conditions.cache: Fresh files and empty translation cache per sample. OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Warmups are retained but excluded from summary statistics.
conditions.order: Forward/reverse variant order alternates every repetition; all samples and axios instrumentation run sequentially in one process.
conditions.payloadComparison: Source payloads must match byte-for-byte across variants. Full request-envelope hashes and equality are reported separately to expose intentional API-envelope changes.
conditions.before: Snapshot source with requested workers 8 resolved through production provider cap 1; original inter-chunk delay is retained.
conditions.current: Requested workers 1/2/4/8 are each resolved through the production provider cap. Requests must never exceed that global cap.
